sources.title: Moonshine · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Moonshine is an encoder-decoder speech recognition model optimized for real-time transcription and recognizing voice command. Instead of using traditional absolute position embeddings, Moonshine uses Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) to handle speech with varying lengths without using padding. This improves efficiency during inference, making it ideal for resource-constrained devices.
